ta.cotrainer.betreff: The assistant coach has picked the line-up
ta.cotrainer.text: You had not handed in a line-up by the evening, so the assistant coach picked the best available eleven: no injured or suspended players and nobody running on empty.
ta.cotrainer.wechsel: Compared with the last line-up he has changed %1 positions.
ta.cotrainer.muede: A few tired players still had to start; otherwise there would have been no eleven.
ta.cotrainer.fehlt.betreff: The assistant coach could not pick a line-up
ta.cotrainer.fehlt.text.unloesbar: You had not handed in a line-up, and the available squad cannot field a full eleven. Check the line-up today.
ta.cotrainer.fehlt.text.abgelehnt: You had not handed in a line-up. The assistant coach prepared an eleven, but the game did not take it. Check the line-up today.
ta.berater.wechselwunsch.text: %1's agent lets you know that his client no longer sees his future here and wants to know whether you would stand in the way of a move. You should have that talk soon.
ta.berater.interesse.text: %1's agent has heard that %2 is interested in his client and asks where you stand. There is no offer yet.
ta.reaktion.antwort.gut.spieler.text: Your answer today did %1 good: he feels taken seriously and goes into training with more backing.
ta.reaktion.antwort.gut.kabine.betreff: The dressing room talks about your answer
ta.reaktion.antwort.gut.kabine.text: Word gets round the dressing room that you gave %1 a clear answer today. The squad sees you are someone you can talk to.
ta.reaktion.antwort.hart.spieler.text: Your answer today was not what %1 wanted to hear. He withdraws and looks closed off in training.
ta.reaktion.antwort.hart.kabine.betreff: Your hard line is the talk of the dressing room
ta.reaktion.antwort.hart.kabine.text: Your refusal to %1 today has reached the dressing room. Some wonder whether they are next.
ta.reaktion.training.kabine.betreff: The squad noticed your training plan
ta.reaktion.training.kabine.text: With the changed training plan you set this week's load today. In the dressing room they already know who looks forward to it and who will feel it.
ta.reaktion.training.presse.text: Journalists watched training and ask why you changed the plan. Expect questions about it tomorrow.
ta.reaktion.aufstellung.presse.text: The line-up for the match is out. Journalists weigh up names and formation and will tell you tomorrow what they think.
ta.reaktion.aufstellung.fans.text: As soon as the line-up was known, fans took it apart in their forums and on the terraces. Their mood hangs on the result.
ta.reaktion.aufstellung.spieler.text: Those who are not in the eleven noted the line-up today. A few on the bench have gone quiet.
ta.reaktion.transfer.presse.text: Today's transfer step involving %1 has leaked. Journalists write about it and ask how he fits your plans.
ta.reaktion.transfer.vorstand.betreff: The board asks about the transfer
ta.reaktion.transfer.vorstand.text: The board noted today's step involving %1 and wants to know what it costs the club and what it brings.
ta.reaktion.transfer.fans.text: Fans have heard about the step involving %1 and are split: some hope for reinforcement, others fear unrest.
ta.reaktion.vertrag.spieler.text: %1 took in that you talked contract with him today. His attitude to the club now depends on what comes of it.
ta.reaktion.vertrag.vorstand.betreff: The board follows the contract talks
ta.reaktion.vertrag.vorstand.text: Your negotiation with %1 reached the board today. It expects the numbers to stay within bounds.
ta.reaktion.vertrag.kabine.betreff: Contract talks are the talk of the dressing room
ta.reaktion.vertrag.kabine.text: The dressing room knows you talked contract with %1 today. Others wonder what is in it for them.
ta.reaktion.versprechen.presse.betreff: Press makes a note of your promise
ta.reaktion.versprechen.presse.text: You promised something today: %1. Journalists note it and will remind you of it when the time comes.
ta.reaktion.versprechen.fans.betreff: Fans take you at your word
ta.reaktion.versprechen.fans.text: Your promise today (%1) spread quickly. Fans take you at your word.
ta.reaktion.versprechen.vorstand.betreff: The board makes a note of your promise
ta.reaktion.versprechen.vorstand.text: The board noted your promise today (%1) and will check whether it is kept.
